Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.platform.swing.builder.components.table

Klasse AbstractTableModelTest

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.platform.swing.builder.components.table.AbstractTableModelTest
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
TestSwingSelectionHandler, TestSwingTableCellEditor, TestSwingTableCellRenderer
public abstract class AbstractTableModelTest extends Object
An abstract test class for tests of Swing table functionality. This class provides common functionality for setting up a table model, a table tag and more.

  • Methodendetails

    • setUpTableTag

      public static AbstractTableModelTest.TableTagTestImpl setUpTableTag(Collection<?> data, boolean width, String scrollWidth, String scrollHeight) throws org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException, FormBuilderException
      Fully initializes a table tag for the test table based on the provided parameters.
      Parameter:
      data - the data collection; can be null, then default data will be created
      width - if set to true, the widths of the columns are set
      scrollWidth - the scroll width as string (can be null)
      scrollHeight - the scroll height as string (can be null)
      Gibt zurück:
      the initialized tag
      Löst aus:
      org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException - if the tag is used incorrectly
      FormBuilderException - if an error occurs

    • setUpTableTag

      public static TableTag setUpTableTag(Collection<?> data, boolean width) throws org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException, FormBuilderException
      Initializes a table tag for the test table according to the specified parameters. No preferred scroll sizes are set.
      Parameter:
      data - the data collection; can be null, then default data will be created
      width - if set to true, the widths of the columns are set
      Gibt zurück:
      the initialized tag
      Löst aus:
      org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException - if the tag is used incorrectly
      FormBuilderException - if an error occurs

    • setUpTableTag

      public static TableTag setUpTableTag(Collection<?> data) throws org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException, FormBuilderException
      Initializes a table tag for the test table. Widths for the columns are set.
      Parameter:
      data - the data collection; can be null, then default data will be created

    • processTableTag

      public static void processTableTag(TableTag tt) throws org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException, FormBuilderException
      Invokes the processBeforeBody() method on the passed in table tag. This method can be used if the tag in its processed form is needed. It assumes that the passed in tag has been created by the setUpTableTag() method.
      Parameter:
      tt - the table tag
      Löst aus:
      FormBuilderException - if an exception occurs
      org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException - if the tag is used incorrectly

    • createTableModel

      protected SwingTableModel createTableModel()
